skill.name: Solar Snare
skill.description: Mel fires a radiant orb forward, rooting those at its center while the area around it slows enemies and deals damage over time.

skill.name: Arctic Assault
skill.description: Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. The charge stops after hitting an enemy champion.

skill.name: Winter's Wrath
skill.description: Sejuani swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks.

skill.name: Glacial Prison
skill.description: Sejuani throws her bola that freezes and stuns the first champion hit and creates an ice storm that slows other enemies.
